1. When an investigative journalist returns to her rust-belt hometown to clear her imprisoned brother’s name, she uncovers a 30-year pattern of “accidental” deaths tied to a shuttered steel mill—and a killer who still reads the obituaries for targets.
2. A new detective in a coastal police unit races to connect a string of dockside suicides before the spring storm erases the last clue—an encoded message carved into driftwood that points back to her own academy class.
3. After a popular morning radio host announces on-air that she’s being stalked, her ratings soar—and so do the threats. As fans blur with suspects, she must decide who to trust before the voice on the other end of the line steps into her studio.
4. In a quiet mountain town, the new sheriff inherits an open case file labeled simply “The Orchard.” Every harvest season, someone vanishes among the trees, and a single apple left on the porch is the only warning.
5. A true-crime podcaster lands an exclusive with a reclusive billionaire widow—then discovers her previous interviewees have died within weeks of airing. To escape becoming the finale, she must solve a locked-room murder that never made the news.
6. A child’s crayon drawing—blue house, red swing, faceless man—matches details from an unsolved abduction twenty years earlier. The lead detective, now retired, returns for one last case as the drawing’s colors begin appearing on her own front steps.
7. Fleeing an abusive ex, a chef opens a diner off a rain-swept highway, only to find her daily specials duplicated on a stranger’s plates before she even writes the menu. Someone is stealing more than recipes—they’re rewriting her past.
8. The bones beneath a newly drained reservoir belong to a family that never existed on paper. A forensic genealogist and a weary sergeant trace a vanished surname through falsified school records, erased land deeds, and a town that prefers its ghosts.
9. A therapist who specializes in memory recovery realizes three patients from different cities recall the same white room, the same ticking clock, the same lullaby. To break the pattern, she must enter the room herself—awake.
10. An abandoned sanatorium lures urban explorers with rumors of a phantom light in the attic. When a photographer captures a repeating figure in every long exposure—hands pressed to the glass, counting down—she teams with a skeptical detective to stop the countdown from reaching zero.
